title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: late-acceptance cut-off hours and review service standard
content:
## What this card covers
This card gives, for each acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, two time parameters of the declaration and review stage: how many hours before the cargo cut-off a late declaration is still accepted at the latest, and the service standard, in hours, for deciding a review.

## Parameters by category
| Category | Late declaration still accepted until, hours before cargo cut-off | Review decided within (hours) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 48 | 24 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 48 | 24 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 72 | 48 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 72 | 48 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 96 | 72 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 168 | 120 |

Both columns are counted in whole hours.

## Basis Q&A
- *Which category closes late acceptance earliest relative to the cargo cut-off?* AHL DG Special Approval, at 168 hours before it.
- *Do any two categories share both figures?* Yes: AHL DG Limited Quantity with AHL DG Class 9 Standard (48 and 24), and AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives with AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers (72 and 48).
- *What is the review service standard of AHL DG Compressed Gases?* 72 hours.
